# KP Glass & Aluminum

> KP Glass & Aluminum Ltd. is a commercial glass and aluminum company in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, serving all of Halifax Regional Municipality (HRM). We provide glazing, aluminum fabrication, curtain walls, storefronts, doors and windows, automatic door operators, accessibility solutions, and service and repairs. Licensed and insured, Red Seal technicians, AAADM certified, A+ BBB rated. Free estimates.

## Contact
- Address: 191 Joseph Zatzman Drive, Unit 11-13, Dartmouth, NS B3B 1M5, Canada
- Phone: 902-406-2595
- Email: info@kp-glass.ca (general inquiries, quotes, and resumes)
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Atlantic Time. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/novascotiaglass/
- LinkedIn: https://ca.linkedin.com/company/kp-glass

## Services
- Commercial glass and glazing: storefront glass, interior and office glass, reception glass, shower glass, glass railings, and other custom glass applications
- Doors and windows engineered for energy efficiency, security, and accessibility
- Automatic door operators and aluminum entrance systems, including automatic sliding doors
- Aluminum fabrication for curtain walls, storefronts, and architectural elements
- Custom solutions from concept to completion
- Service and repairs for glazing, aluminum doors, windows, and automatic door operators
- Accessibility solutions: automatic door operators, barrier-free entrances, accessible ramps and washrooms. Ask about the Government of Canada's Enabling Accessibility Fund (EAF).

## Key facts
- Service area: all of HRM, including Halifax, Dartmouth, Bedford, Sackville, and surrounding communities. Projects outside HRM are reviewed case by case.
- Warranty: 1 year on workmanship; main product Windspec carries a 2-year warranty from date of invoice.
- Permits can be handled by KP or by the client. KP can design or build from supplied plans.
- Clients include general contractors, property managers, building owners, businesses, institutions, developers, and residential clients. Much of the work is commercial.
- Featured projects: Shannex (West Bedford Transitional Health), Dalhousie University Killam Memorial Library, IKEA Halifax.
- Sister company: Creek Ocean Construction (general contracting, renovations, custom millwork): https://creek.construction/
